svg.title: Mac — Voices and replies
svg.desc: Original static settings design. Synthetic labels and source-default previews only; no runtime queries, audio, configuration writes or app behavior.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: A host-owned voice map survives restarts. Every override names its source.
Effective state not queried. Proposed controls require supported host capabilities.
Proposed coordination default. Catalog availability must be confirmed by the host.
A target override belongs to the host map, not the replying session.
Proposed status lane. Ordinary replies and coordination remain separate.
Explicit per-reply override only. No silent caller-environment voice selection.
A preview is an explicit action, never automatic on opening this screen.
Silences replies. It does not stop the microphone or request privacy.
Default 1.5 s · allowed 0.1–10 s. Applies to the next scheduled pause.
Default 0.3 s · allowed 0.05–2 s. Any sustained sound may take a turn.
Legacy wrapper default is FRIDAY (main); proposed map must replace silent selection.
HS supplies 160 when absent. Sentence boundaries may exceed this target.
Default 170. Nonpositive means one group; this is not a strict sentence limit.
VOICE_RATE is a Python table used by vbcast, not an HS vbsay environment variable.
Unsupported rate/filter paths stay visible with a reason; no false speed slider.
Continue in All settings for every field, source and prerequisite. This frame shows representative controls.
STATIC DESIGN · representative category content · synthetic labels · no runtime effects
